claim: The repository README is a succinct front door - pitch, the two commitments, use cases, the sixty-second demo, quick start, a documentation map, honest status - and stays near 100 lines. Narrative, reference, and worked-example material lives in docs/ files linked from the README's Documentation section (mental-model.md, codepaths.md, eval-ledger.md, reference.md, worked-example-eval-verdict.md). New deep material is added as or into a docs/ file and linked from the map, never appended to the README.

evidence.detail: The README had grown to 818 lines - a full manual fronting the repo. The operator asked whether a succinct README with expansive documentation elsewhere is a standard practice (it is: short README plus docs/ directory, Diataxis-shaped), then directed the split. Commit 0b8da60 reduced the README to 95 lines and moved the four deep sections verbatim into five docs/ files with cross-references retargeted. Minted at /end so the settled convention outlives the chat. Preflight 2026-06-12: clean - zero matches in all four buckets; no existing directive governs README or docs/ structure.
